Companion Animal Travel Desk Guidance

This section sets the simple handling rules for pet travel records and customer support at Aurelia Skyways. Staff should greet each traveler with calm, clear language, confirm the animal's basic care needs, and make sure the desk notes reflect any change in service or handling.

Bookings are accepted only when the required paperwork is complete, the animal details are entered clearly, and the traveler has been told what to expect before departure. <<FACT F085>> Staff should keep the desk ledger neat and current, because it helps the next shift follow the same plan without confusion. If a care plan needs to be adjusted for species, temperament, or comfort, the update should be recorded right away and shared with the right team member.

When a pet arrives for pickup, staff should stay patient, keep the area low-stress, and use the usual handoff steps so the traveler feels supported. <<FACT F107>> If the animal seems restless, staff should slow the process, speak gently, and check for any note that affects comfort or movement. Food, water, bedding, and carrier handling should match the approved care notes, and any concern should be written down before the case is closed.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk should always leave the traveler with clear next steps and a steady point of contact. For help with a record, a care note, or a service change, contact the senior coordinator or the desk lead.
